verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ollama shipped a native desktop app with a GUI chat interface for macOS and Windows, with hands-on reports of multimodal and Markdown support working as expected (ollama-comm-16, ollama-comm-18). However, hands-on reports also flag real gaps: no Linux support at launch, no way to connect the GUI to a remote Ollama instance, and some community pushback that building a client was scope creep rather than core value (ollama-comm-17, ollama-comm-19, ollama-comm-20). Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the GUI's feature set, Linux support confirmation, and remote-instance connectivity.
